title: 区分的语法：五个领域，同一个二次型 / The Grammar of Distinction — Five Domains, One Quadratic Form
description:
版本说明（本次新版本）。本书是同一 DOI 的一个新版本。本版完成一次归并：初稿把框架写成三个原语——区分、曲率、演化；进一步的分析把它们收敛为两个更基本的词，语言由此更简洁、也更一般。本版因此从“一个统一理论”转为“一套语言描述”。

定位：语言规范／探索性框架（Language Specification · Exploratory Framework）。本书交付的不是新的统一理论，而是一套以“区分”为线索的语言：区分动作、不可区分关系，以及把“区分”定量化的对称双线性形式（二次型）。协方差、Hessian、图拉普拉斯、内积、黎曼度量都是它的实例；谱定理、变分原理、极化恒等式是它自带的三套工具。第 12—14 章把这套语言写清楚，并把形式推广到辛（反对称）与酉（埃尔米特）。

归并记录（R1—R4，附录 E，append-only）。R1：「曲率」是形式谱的一个侧写——离散 κ_info=Var(λ)/2 与连续热核系数 a₁=R/6 是类型不同的两个量（平坦环面 R=0 而 κ_info=2.000）。R2：「演化」是形式谱上的线性 ODE，归并入形式，使动力学自动继承谱定理与变分原理。R3：1/3 缺口定位为一个可继续检验的量。R4：六元组＋六公理归并为两个基本词（区分、形式）。

唯一完全严格的部分是图拉普拉斯二次型的谱分析：区分耦合越过两个由拉普拉斯谱决定的临界值 β₁=α/λₙ、β₂=α/λ₂ 时，系统经历“局部先于全局”的两阶段相变；证明只用实对称矩阵的谱定理与线性 ODE，可用随书脚本复算。本书明确它是标准数学（换形式），不是新理论。此外报告两次“换形式”的推广：辛推广给出可计算的阻尼波动方程临界阻尼 γ_k=2√λ_k，酉推广新意有限。

如何评价这套语言。标准不是“今天证了多少定理”，而是它是否被采用、是否压缩了记号、是否让跨领域迁移变得可读（第 26.4.1 节）。本版如实标明：采纳一项今天为零——这正好把下一步写清楚了。一套语言要证明自己，靠的不是再宣布一次统一，而是被人拿去使用。附录 E 为每个可反驳命题登记证伪条件与核验日期（append-only）。

源码、构建流程、可复现数值脚本与可证伪登记簿见 GitHub。内容许可 CC BY 4.0；代码许可 MIT。

Version note. This is a new version of the same DOI. It performs a consolidation: the first draft framed the work around three primitives — distinction, curvature, evolution; further analysis converges them into two more basic words, making the language simpler and more general. The book is therefore repositioned from a unified theory to a language specification.

Positioning: language specification / exploratory framework. The book delivers not a new unified theory but a language of “distinction”: distinction actions, indistinguishability, and the symmetric bilinear form (quadratic form) that quantifies distinction. Covariance, the Hessian, the graph Laplacian, the inner product and the Riemannian metric are its instances; the spectral theorem, the variational principle and the polarization identity are its built-in tools. Chapters 12–14 state the language and extend it to the symplectic (antisymmetric) and unitary (Hermitian) cases.

Consolidation record (R1–R4, Appendix E, append-only). R1: “curvature” is a profile of the form’s spectrum — the discrete κ_info = Var(λ)/2 and the continuous heat-kernel coefficient a₁ = R/6 are different types (flat torus: R = 0 while κ_info = 2.000). R2: “evolution” is a linear ODE on the form’s spectrum, consolidated into the form so that dynamics inherits the spectral theorem and the variational principle. R3: the factor-of-1/3 gap is located as a quantity open to further testing. R4: the six-tuple plus six axioms are consolidated into two basic words (distinction, form).

The only fully rigorous part is the spectral analysis of the graph Laplacian quadratic form: as the distinction coupling crosses two spectral thresholds β₁ = α/λₙ and β₂ = α/λ₂, the system undergoes a two-stage transition in which local distinctions unlock before global ones. The proof uses only the spectral theorem for real symmetric matrices and linear ODEs, and is reproducible with the accompanying scripts. The book explicitly labels this standard mathematics (a change of form), not a new theory. Two “change-of-form” extensions are also reported: the symplectic one yields a computable damped-wave critical damping γ_k = 2√λ_k; the unitary one adds little.

How to evaluate the language. Not by how many theorems it proves today, but by whether it is adopted, whether it compresses notation, and whether it makes cross-domain transfer readable (Section 26.4.1). This version states plainly that adoption is currently zero — which is exactly what sets the next step. A language proves itself not by declaring unification again, but by being used. Appendix E registers a falsification condition and a check date for every refutable proposition (append-only).

Source, build pipeline, reproducible scripts and the falsification ledger: GitHub. Content licensed CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
